specs_json.compute: proprietary DJI flight controller with dual-radar fusion

notes: Flagship agricultural drone with 40 kg spray / 50 kg spread payload, coaxial dual-rotor design and dual phased-array radars for terrain follow and obstacle sensing. Weighs 52 kg with the 30 Ah DB1560 battery; typically operated with rapid battery swaps and generator charging in the field.

failure_modes.name: Spray nozzle clogging
failure_modes.symptoms: Uneven spray pattern, flow rate deviation alerts, reduced coverage
failure_modes.mitigation: Flush tank and lines after each session; use filtered mixture; replace centrifugal nozzle discs on schedule

failure_modes.name: Coaxial motor/ESC overheat
failure_modes.symptoms: ESC temperature warnings, power derating, forced landing
failure_modes.mitigation: Avoid sustained max-payload hover in high ambient temps; clean motor cooling paths; firmware-current limits

failure_modes.name: RTK fix loss near obstacles
failure_modes.symptoms: Degrades to GNSS float, swath drift, boundary overshoot
failure_modes.mitigation: Site D-RTK 2 base station with clear sky view; enable vision fallback; re-plan routes away from tree lines

failure_modes.name: Phased-array radar false negatives on wires
failure_modes.symptoms: No avoidance response to thin power lines or guy wires
failure_modes.mitigation: Manually mark linear obstacles in field plan; maintain altitude buffer; pre-flight field survey

failure_modes.name: Battery connector corrosion from chemical exposure
failure_modes.symptoms: Intermittent power, voltage sag warnings, boot failures
failure_modes.mitigation: Rinse airframe after spraying, inspect and dielectric-grease connectors, rotate battery packs

failure_modes.name: Pump impeller wear from abrasive slurries
failure_modes.symptoms: Reduced L/min flow, pump current spikes
failure_modes.mitigation: Use recommended formulations; replace impellers per hour schedule; avoid dry running
